verdict.rationale: Mastra is a code-first TypeScript framework. The things its Studio UI does (testing agents, running workflows, inspecting traces) map to documented programmatic capabilities: agents, workflows, suspend/resume, observability and a deployable Mastra server. However, no documentation states or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or reference covering every Studio action, documented server HTTP endpoints/OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Studio: A hosted visual environment for testing agents and running workflows, plus inspecting traces
You can deploy a Mastra server or integrate with an existing web framework.
Use resume() to restart a suspended workflow from the step where it paused.
Mastra's observability system gives you visibility into every agent run, workflow step, tool call, and model interaction.
